purpose: SVR4 OPRF protocol parity: encryption_key KDF label and passwordToUniformInput KDF label

vectors.name: encryption_key_zeros_ones
vectors.description: Rust svrb::test::output_to_encryption (lib.rs:581-586): encryption_key(&[0u8;32], &[1u8;32]). Derives the 32-byte encryption key via HKDF-SHA256 over the concatenation of s_enc and k_auth, with info='Signal_SVR_EncryptionKey_20240823'. This is the only hardcoded KAT in the Rust svrb test module.

vectors.name: password_to_uniform_input_known
vectors.description: passwordToUniformInput derives 64 bytes from a password using HKDF-SHA256 with info='Signal_SVR_InputFromPassword_20240823', IKM=password, no salt. This verifies the KDF label and output length used before OPRF blinding.

vectors.name: password_to_uniform_input_empty
vectors.description: passwordToUniformInput with empty password. Verifies the KDF handles zero-length IKM correctly (HKDF-SHA256 with empty IKM is well-defined).

vectors.name: encrypt_decrypt_secret_round_trip
vectors.description: EncryptSecret + DecryptSecret round-trip using AES-256-GCM-SIV with a zero nonce. The key is a one-time derived key making nonce reuse safe per the SVR4 design. This exercises the same code path as the Rust svrb restore protocol's encryption_secretshare recovery.
